revision_note: The exact relative5r2 and eleven needed geometric producers from107r2 are retained. Tensor induction proves that the ORIGINAL extension adjunction unit spans the entire extended module, and the actual extension comparison transports that statement to the ORIGINAL chart restriction. Positive and reciprocal coefficient maps are constructed by those same units; coefficient linearity and polynomial semilinearity are derived from their actual scalar actions. Thus the final arbitrary-commutative-ring coefficient quotient vanishing theorem needs only the actual finite positive polynomial module and the two genuine extension isomorphisms. It no longer assumes finite overlap bases, monomial stability, scalar laws or localization-spanning. The geometric consumer separately identifies the SAME comparison-unit map with the OLD pullback-unit restriction through OriginalTensorChartRestriction.overlap_unit, so actual affine tensor-overlap sections span over the original base ring for every original line. No domain, reducedness, flatness or freeness is introduced by these new results. The geometric tensor chart is supplied as an actual scheme isomorphism with both exact projection squares; no arbitrary family is inferred to possess that chart. Actual arbitrary-test Contact chart construction, relative derived cohomology/base-change and nonreduced affine acyclicity still remain to join before any relative geometric H1 or represented Picard conclusion. Static source checks only; hosted elaboration/audit and independent acceptance remain pending. No local Lean compilation.
